LANGUAGE/FALLBACK: 208 working adults in Shanghai recruited via WeChat, so the administration was Chinese; the deposit and the article contain no Chinese text at all (checked: all 363 CJK characters in the .xlsx XML are font names and Excel UI strings in theme/styles/comment rich-text runs and docProps -- no comment string and no cell value contains CJK; the scraped article text contains 0), and the only other supplements are a TIF figure and the IRB approval PDF. The agent's RIGHTS paragraph above is the ECR-R source-licence reading (the deposit is CC BY 4.0, so the wording ships), which was the operative rule when it was written. It is superseded, and applying the supersession is not a new decision -- the same override was made one round earlier on lindstrom2021_honesty_humility. The RCBS is copyrighted 1983 by Jonathan M. Cheek and its 1983 source document states: 'The scale may be used in non-profit educational research without further explicit permission', with commercial or other use directed to the author for current licensing requirements. That is a STATED USE RESTRICTION by the originator, the hexaco.org shape, and #1945 (2026-09-05, 'err on the side of not having things. so do not host.') makes any such restriction sufficient to block on its own -- the fee and no-redistribution tests the agent applied are explicitly no longer sufficient. The originator ruling of 2026-09-08 meets the CC BY argument head on: a deposit reproducing a restricted instrument does not launder it. The deposit's cell comments reproduce Cheek's 13 items verbatim and in canonical order, which the agent's own cross-check establishes, so this IS the restricted wording rather than a study-specific rewrite. Held rather than withdrawn, since nothing was ever uploaded: the CSV and its sidecars stay in this batch directory and shipping it later is one upload.
